page.notes: Scan shows the index as two columns; the first and last lines of the right column are cut by the page edge. Several numbers are partly obscured (e.g. 1151, 1234, 1252 region). Line "XXXI" reads 1235 with a second number 1234 in parentheses, uncertain. The running head is the title "INDEX CAPITVM." The line "SYSTE-" at the foot is a catchword-like word, printed at the lower right. Lines "Cap.I. De voce" and similar in LIBER II of the ecclesiastical section are read with some doubt; the page edge and show-through obscure the lower-right area.
